companies.name: アトリア・シニア・リビング

relations.text: 同社が34%を保有する出資先で、同社の住宅物件を運営している
relations.text_en: Atria is a 34%-owned investee that manages Ventas SHOP properties

source.label: Ventas 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we held a 34% ownership interest in Atria, which entitles us to customary minority rights and protections, as well as the right to appoint two members to the Atria Board of Directors.

relations.text: 同社のSHOP物件を運営し、収益と営業利益の相当部分を占める
relations.text_en: Atria manages SHOP properties that account for a significant portion of segment revenues and NOI

source.label: Ventas 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The properties in our SHOP segment managed by Atria, Sunrise Senior Living, LLC (together with its subsidiaries, “Sunrise”) and Le Groupe Maurice (together with its subsidiaries, “Le Groupe Maurice”) accounted for a significant portion of our SHOP segment revenues and NOI for the year ended December 31, 2025.
